name: Pitch Bend Mode
description: Multi: existing channels 1-3 routing; Omni: bend from any MIDI channel controls all three operators

name: Op1 Sustain Pedal
description: Enable MIDI CC64 sustain hold for operator 1 (default Off)

name: Op2 Sustain Pedal
description: Enable MIDI CC64 sustain hold for operator 2 (default Off)

name: Op3 Sustain Pedal
description: Enable MIDI CC64 sustain hold for operator 3 (default Off)

name: Chord Op1 Controls
description: Only in Chord Allocate, Op1 controls the other operators ADSR, portamento, pedal CC64 enable, Level, and PWM. Default independent; waves, pitch, pan and modulation stay independent.

name: LFO1 Square PWM
description: Duty cycle of the Square waveform for this LFO (not operator Pulse Width). Zero-point-five is a 50% square.

name: LFO2 Square PWM

name: LFO3 Square PWM
description: Duty cycle of the Square waveform for this LFO (not operator Pulse Width). Zero-point-five is a 50% square.
